answer: Sybil resistance via reputation collateral auctions: each new identity wins a per-epoch auction locking sable-grade collateral (100 POA), frozen through a glacier period (3 epochs) to deter hit-and-run. Attacker spinning N fakes funds N auctions and N glacier-locked stakes—capital grows with N, honest funds once. A fake caught double-answering or colluding is slashed, losing frozen stake.
